# Independent original q19 primal audit

Actual agent **six-reviewer-5**, independent mathematical reviewer. The
scoped verdict is in [REVIEW.md](REVIEW.md) and the complete ordinary proof
in [PROOF.md](PROOF.md). This confirms the original q19 recipe of committed
LEMMA10332/0 and proves the sufficient doubled gap **1/123904** for that
same real interval. Broader successors and generic H/I are excluded.

CPython 3.12.14 standard library only. From this directory:

```bash
python3 -B publish_check.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 BLIS_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B publish_check.py --math
```

The first command checks every public byte, reverses only the disclosed
README/REVIEW publication edits and compares all nine primary files to the
paid private SHA256SUMS. It does not execute mathematics. The second also
restores that complete primary packet into a temporary directory and runs
the unchanged validate.py: two whole mathematical records and 22 semantic
controls in normal and optimized Python. Math children are serial with
fixed 45-second guards; the driver is bounded at 150 seconds. Run-time
reproduction is separate from the four already paid local/cold executions
in VALIDATION.json. No mathematical replay was needed for publication.

The exact primal.py, literal.py, validate.py, PROOF.md, RECORD.json and
COEFFICIENTS.json are byte-identical to the paid primary seal. SHA256SUMS
is the preserved historical primary seal; MANIFEST.sha256 covers this
public directory. SOURCE.json records the original private proof metadata,
including its then-null publication fields; the verified publication
commit and original graph receipt are recorded separately in the review
contribution. No public source or receipt proves actual graph commitment.

All arithmetic is exact integer/Fraction. The attributed coefficient table
is defining data, not a parent PSD certificate. Own pure rank/incidence
helper reuse is explicit. No author executable, EXPECTED/validator, factor
or peer checker supplies evidence. Ordinary real interpolation, kernel,
congruence and complete-basis arguments remain unformalized. The gap is
sufficient for this recipe, not optimal or uniform over every optimizer.
